📖 How to use

  1. Paste or type your text.
  2. Press Remove Vowels.
  3. Copy the disemvoweled result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is disemvoweling?

Disemvoweling removes all a, e, i, o, u letters (both cases) — a classic trick for spoiling text while keeping it barely readable.

Does it count the vowels it removed?

Yes — the tool shows the vowel count and the number of characters removed.

What about accented vowels like é or ü?

Accents are kept; only plain ASCII vowels a/e/i/o/u are stripped.
